# ignitify_user (Resource)

A user of the tenant. A user holds API keys and gets permissions from its groups. Needs an owner key. Deleting a user revokes all its keys.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "ignitify_user" "ci" {
  name = "ci"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The user name, unique in the tenant (1 to 63 lower case letters, digits and '-', starting with a letter or digit). A change replaces the user. The import id.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) When the user was created (ISO 8601).
- `resource_id` (String) The server id of the user.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# The import id is the user name.
terraform import ignitify_user.ci ci
```
